positives.name: safety web
positives.enterReply: You feel the pod begin to slide down its ejection tube as explosions shake the mother ship. /   / >get in web / You are now safely cushioned within the web. /   / Through the viewport of the pod you see the Feinstein dwindle as you head away. Bursts of light dot its hull. Suddenly, a huge explosion blows the Feinstein into tiny pieces, sending the escape pod tumbling away!  /   / As the escape pod tumbles away from the former location of the Feinstein, its gyroscopes whine. The pod slowly stops
positives.exitReply: This is one of the Feinstein's primary escape pods, for use in extreme emergencies. A mass of safety webbing, large enough to hold several dozen people, fills half the pod. The controls are entirely automated. The bulkhead leading out is closed. /   / The auxiliary rockets fire briefly, and a nearby planet swings into view through the port.
